template: On the ticket detail page for {{v1}} ('{{v2}}', currently status {{v4}}), do two things in order: (1) remove/delete BOTH parts ('{{v5}}' and '{{v6}}') using whatever delete affordance each row offers, confirming any dialog that appears, and wait for the parts table to refresh after each deletion (it refreshes a short beat after the mutation — wait on concrete page state, not the first render) until the table shows no parts / an empty state; (2) then ARCHIVE the ticket using whatever archive affordance the page offers (an Archive button, an action menu, etc.), confirming any dialog. If archiving is blocked by a precondition, read the exact error text, satisfy it, and retry. Wait for the list/detail view to refresh and verify the ticket is archived (e.g. it no longer appears in the active tickets list, or shows an archived indicator). Report: the parts table state after both deletions, the exact confirmation text shown for the archive action, and the final state of the ticket (where it appears, its status, any archived indicator).

reportTemplate.summary: On /#/tickets/{{v7}} I deleted both parts via each row's "Delete" button; each opened a custom "Confirm" modal with the text "Delete the part \"<name>\" from this ticket? This cannot be undone." and a "Delete part" button. After confirming both, the parts table settled to the empty state "No parts on this ticket yet." (and the list row now shows 0 parts). I then clicked "Archive ticket" — no confirmation dialog or message appeared at all; the action applied immediately and the button flipped to "Unarchive ticket" (so no precondition blocked archiving and no confirmation text was shown). Final state read from the page: detail view shows Status "{{v4}}" plus an "Archived" badge, buttons now "Mark Draft", "Mark Closed", "Unarchive ticket"; on the tickets list the ticket is gone from the default (active) view — count dropped 14 → 13 and the list starts at RD-1014 — and with "Show archived" ticked the row reads "{{v1}} | {{v2}} Archived | Bench Customer | {{v4}} | 0 parts | 2026-09-18".
